mentions.name: Gave
mentions.description: A wish list app for families on iPhone and iPad. People who follow a user can see which gifts are free, reserved, or bought so nobody receives the same gift twice, while the server never sends users the status of their own wishes — including via notifications, widgets, Siri, and Spotlight. Features include a "Hide status" switch for shopping with the recipient, private notes and secret gift ideas, a view of upcoming birthdays and holidays with preparedness status, and an MCP server for connecting AI agents. It offers a very native experience with Spotlight, Siri, deep linking, notifications, and Apple Intelligence integration. Free with no ads, subscription, analytics, or affiliate links; data lives on a server in Norway. Built with native SwiftUI on iOS 26 and Laravel/Postgres on the backend, with English support alongside Norwegian as the default language.
mentions.problem: Each Christmas there were numerous bad solutions to making sure nobody knew what they got while still making sure that nobody got double up of something they wished for.
mentions.audience: Families coordinating gift wish lists so no one receives duplicate gifts and recipients don't see their own wish statuses
mentions.source_excerpt:
Gave (https://gave.skar.cloud/en) a wish list app for families available on iPhone and iPad.

"Gave" is Norwegian for "gift". It started as something I built for my family as each Christmas there were numerous bad solutions to making sure nobody knew what they got while still making sure that nobody got double up of something they wished for.
